name: 23000-gsm8kbatch-qwen8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B as the target, z-lab/Qwen3-8B-DFlash-b16 as the draft head; both ungated, 18.5 GB of weights together. The draft was trained against this exact target and is not interchangeable with another checkpoint.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp1. Forced as well as declared: this engine refuses DFLASH with data-parallel attention or pp_size > 1.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 1280 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: Five-shot GSM8K in this engine's own gsm8k completion format, shipped as configs/data/gsm8k-5shot-1319.jsonl: all 1319 rows of the test split, raw text to /v1/completions, no chat template. Prompts are 854 tokens mean (sd 22, min 816, max 981) including a 789-token five-shot preamble common to every row; greedy (temperature 0.0, top_p 1.0, top_k 1), capped at 2048 new tokens with the harness's three stop strings, generations stopping naturally near 124 tokens.
purpose: A grade-school math solver with a draft model, 32 concurrent few-shot prompts sharing a long preamble, one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at the commit named by `commit_id` in setupcard.md; the interpreter is `env.yaml: venv`.
# Nothing here is tuned: every key is the model, the topology, or the speculation shape, and
# everything not named is a stock default of this commit.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tp-size: 1

# Both models are native architectures in this engine's registry, so `trust-remote-code` is
# deliberately NOT set even though the draft repo carries an `auto_map`.
speculative-algorithm: DFLASH
speculative-draft-model-path: z-lab/Qwen3-8B-DFlash-b16

# Written down rather than left for the engine to read off the draft config; same value either
# way. `speculative-num-steps` and `speculative-eagle-topk` do not apply to this algorithm.
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 16

# fa3 on both; the sm100-only backends (trtllm_mha, fa4) do not exist on an H100. An unsupported
# draft backend is not an error here -- the worker warns and falls back to flashinfer, i.e. runs a
# different setup at rc=0. fa3 clears `causal` for the draft's ENCODER_ONLY type, which it needs.
attention-backend: fa3
speculative-draft-attention-backend: fa3
